                    The introduction of the penalty method in the Navier–Stokes equations was 
                 done in R. Temam [2a], [2b] at the general level of the complete equations (non-
                 linear time dependent Navier–Stokes equations). Numerous applications of the 
                 penalty method to finite element methods and numerical computation in flow prob-
                 lems have been developed; see T. Kawai [1] and the bibliography therein.
